programme.title: Наседка
programme.desc: Преподаватель младших классов в частной школе Надя Косенкова очень любит свою работу и учеников. За это ее прозвали Наседкой. Надя мечтает о собственном ребенке, но в планы ее мужа, Влада, директора той же школы, дети "не вписываются". А вскоре и вовсе выясняется, что он давно уже изменяет Наде. Узнав о предательстве мужа, Надя увольняется. Так, в один день, Надя теряет и семью, и работу. В это же время трагедия случается в семье Надиной ученицы, Лизы Аксеновой. Прямо в день рождения девочки в дорожной аварии погибает ее мама. Отец Лизы, Алексей, никогда не был близок с дочерью и совсем не понимает, как ему теперь наладить с ней контакт. Тем более, что девочка после смерти матери находится в тяжелом психологическом состоянии. Единственный человек, который может сейчас достучаться до нее – это Надя. Увидев это, Алексей предлагает Наде на некоторое время стать домашним учителем Лизы. Так Надя попадает в большой загородный дом Аксеновых и невольно окажется участницей большой и опасной игры, связанной с деятельностью Алексея. Вскоре обнаружится, что его жена погибла не случайно и все, кто находятся рядом с ним подвергаются большой опасности.

programme.title: Почта
programme.desc: В почтовое отделение на должность экспедитора устраивается Елена (40 лет). Экспедитор Андрей (45) не очень доволен новой напарницей, он не доверяет женщинам за рулем. Но со временем между Еленой и Андреем возникает симпатия. И не без стараний со стороны их детей – Юли и Глеба. Андрей – одинокий папа, Елена - одинокая мама, казалось бы, ничего не может помешать их отношениям… Но тайны и ошибки прошлого сыграют с ними злую шутку… Бушуют страсти и в почтовом отделении. Руководитель отделения Артем (30) покоряет вершины почтовой карьеры и не желает замечать сотрудницу отделения Милану (25), которая мечтает заполучить его сердце. Мама Артема и его младший брат Гена также вносят в жизнь отделения свои коррективы… Все герои ежедневно сталкиваются с нестандартными ситуациями, но не остаются равнодушными к проблемам людей-клиентов почтового отделения, помогая им выпутаться из сложных историй…

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Окно жизни
programme.desc: Славик и Надежда оказываются жертвами квартирных аферистов, поэтому после рождения второго ребёнка они вынуждены жить с семьёй Славика. Его сестра Алёна недовольна таким соседством. Славик уезжает на заработки. Пользуясь тем, что Славик в коме, Алёна выгоняет Надежду с детьми из квартиры. После длительных скитаний Надежда оставляет младенца в бэби-боксе. Соколова и Борадзе предлагают Глаше уволиться по собственному желанию. Борадзе сообщает коллективу о том, что подкидыша усыновила семья Нескоромовых. Коллектив перинатального центра прощается с Милославской - сердце коллеги остановилось. Славик выходит из комы, Алёна признается ему в своем вранье.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Новенькая
programme.desc: В элитную школу для детей богатых родителей попадает Вера - девушка из обычной семьи. Она сразу оказывается в центре запутанной детективной интриги и школьных конфликтов, и, конечно же, романтической истории. Но все не так просто: у Веры также есть тайна, и в элитном заведении она оказалась случайно...

programme.title: Медное колечко
programme.desc: Эта сильная и пронзительная история расскажет о судьбах влюбленных Веры и Романа. Из-за интриг девушка и парень поссорятся и расстанутся, Роман окажется в инвалидной коляске, а Вера потеряет с ним связь... Главным героям предстоит выяснить, кто им друг, а кто пытается разрушить их жизнь. Сможет ли Роман самостоятельно передвигаться? Встретятся ли герои снова? Сохранят свои чувства?

programme.title: Почта
programme.desc: В почтовое отделение на должность экспедитора устраивается Елена (40 лет). Экспедитор Андрей (45) не очень доволен новой напарницей, он не доверяет женщинам за рулем. Но со временем между Еленой и Андреем возникает симпатия. И не без стараний со стороны их детей – Юли и Глеба. Андрей – одинокий папа, Елена - одинокая мама, казалось бы, ничего не может помешать их отношениям… Но тайны и ошибки прошлого сыграют с ними злую шутку… Бушуют страсти и в почтовом отделении. Руководитель отделения Артем (30) покоряет вершины почтовой карьеры и не желает замечать сотрудницу отделения Милану (25), которая мечтает заполучить его сердце. Мама Артема и его младший брат Гена также вносят в жизнь отделения свои коррективы… Все герои ежедневно сталкиваются с нестандартными ситуациями, но не остаются равнодушными к проблемам людей-клиентов почтового отделения, помогая им выпутаться из сложных историй…

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau
programme.desc: In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

programme.title: Deserter
programme.desc: Unlikely friends in a melting pot of confusion. Simon Murray fights for the French Foreign Legion. Pascal Dupont fights for himself. War torn men question honour, hope, morality...because you can desert everything...except yourself.

programme.title: Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: The great Wesley Snipes (Blade himself!) stars as "The Hunter" in this Mauro Borrelli (The Ghostmaker) directed film. The Recall also stars RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) and Hannah Rose May (Ballers). The movie tells the tale of five friends vacationing at a remote lake house, expecting nothing less than a good time. Unbeknownst to them, Earth is under an alien invasion and in the thralls of a mass-abduction. Director Borelli is a former collaborator of director Tim Burton and the film illustrator for blockbuster films such as Pirates of the Caribbean and Captain America. The Recall will also be shot for the new Barco Escape three-screen, panoramic theatrical format, which fully surrounds audiences and offers the ultimate immersive cinema experience. Portions of the films will also be shot in Virtual Reality.

programme.title: Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions
programme.desc: A hybrid of animated, experimental, feature and genre film in found footage technique, with a radio phonic sound and of unexpected, almost 40-minute duration. Journalist Isidor Dukas visits the Institute for Research on Psychic Phenomena and Mental Film when a confrontation with one of the test subjects transforms a routine check into a never-ending maze. Barić's work calls into question issues surrounding artistic practices in the digital age including ideas about authenticity, simulation/replication and appropriation.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Corner Office
programme.desc: Orson, a compulsive bureaucrat who discovers a secret room.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Summer Dreams
programme.desc: Seventeen-year old Robbie Zirpollo has a problem. As the film opens, his mother is driving him to his new summer job. We learn that Robbie has grown up in Oceanside, California, but now he and his mother have moved to Colorado for a fresh start, as his father has taken the family's savings and his secretary to Mexico. Robbie's mom has, through an uncle, gotten him a summer job at Water World on the grounds crew. The adventure begins when Robbie meets Alex and gets moved to Aokee's Surf & Snack shack to work. Alex convinces Robbie to enter the park's "Employee Olympics" to bring the Surfer King trophy to it's rightful place among the concessions crew. Tiffany, the park owner's daughter, has other ideas for Robbie.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

programme.title: Cookies Fortune
programme.desc: Cookie's Fortune unfolds over an eventful Easter weekend in the small town of Holly Springs, Mississippi. The town residents are peaceful, kind folk--with the exception of Camille Dixon (Glenn Close) - a pushy theatre director with an incredibly shy younger sister, Cora (Julianne Moore), whose estranged daughter Emma (Liv Tyler) has just returned to town. On the heels of her latest play, Camille is shocked to discover that her Aunt Jewel Mae "Cookie" Orcutt (Patricia Neal) has committed suicide. Terrified at the thought of how this will tarnish the family name, she eats the suicide note to make it look like a burglary. This set-up leads the police to one main suspect, Willis Richland (Charles S. Dutton), who also happens to be Cookie's best friend. Although the rest of the town is convinced Willis didn't commit the crime, an outside investigator (Courtney B. Vance) isn't so sure. As Easter Sunday and opening night of the play arrive, the truth comes out, revealing more secrets than anyone could have possibly imagined.

programme.title: Timber the Treasure Dog
programme.desc: A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus).

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: Foolproof
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

programme.title: Baba
programme.desc: An weird but witty old woman is forced to deal with an ambiguous future after her country, family and the entire system of values are ruined. She is trying to solve her existential problems catching d trying to sell a rewarded war criminal as he was a rabbit in a wood. The only thing she did not know if he is really him.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: The first episode of a medical crime thriller series following a team of investigators as they uncover corruption and negligence. Dr Lucinda Edwards is a smart and experienced A and E doctor in the midst of a nightmare shift - she has a gunshot victim and an opioid overdose patient who both need a bed in resus, but there's only room for one of them. When one of the patients dies, Lucinda realises that her troubles have only just begun as she faces a probe by the Medical Investigation Unit.

programme.title: Edith
programme.desc: After the death of his wife Edith, Jake feels like he has lost the chance to confront his past. He is convinced that Edith is haunting him for having lived a lie and for having never challenged her about the legitimacy of their son. "Edith" explores how we move on from bereavements. How we make peace with our past and find something worth living for.

programme.title: Second Acts
programme.desc: When a woman reports her daughter as missing, the Blue Heelers find she has moved in with her schoolteacher.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Young Jim Hawkins and Peg-legged Long John Silver set sail for adventure in Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale of dastardly pirates, swashbuckling heroes, buried treasure, and a young boy's courage during the adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Departure
programme.desc: Two broken souls meet by chance on countryside. A man and a woman, neither of them young anymore, both saddled with the great disappointments. They understand one another, even without need of many words, each providing the other with support and solace for this brief section of life's journey which they share. Cinema has taken many different roads to tell stories of despair, pain, grief and loneliness. Yet this film forges its own unique path. It leads from an abandoned carpenter's workshop via a run-down old house to a port. The pace is sedate, the whole area deserted. A bottle of schnapps, a bouquet of gladioli, a few apples and potatoes, a photograph, a suitcase and a book of Russian poems - these are the only props needed for the minimalist plot.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: Action movie. American action, produced in 2017. FBI agent Gretchen Blair receives a strange offer from a fellow passenger regarding an impending hijacking. She soon finds herself trapped in a mid-air heist, fighting to protect everyone on board.

programme.title: Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions
programme.desc: A hybrid of animated, experimental, feature and genre film in found footage technique, with a radio phonic sound and of unexpected, almost 40-minute duration. Journalist Isidor Dukas visits the Institute for Research on Psychic Phenomena and Mental Film when a confrontation with one of the test subjects transforms a routine check into a never-ending maze. Barić's work calls into question issues surrounding artistic practices in the digital age including ideas about authenticity, simulation/replication and appropriation.

programme.title: Talea
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

programme.title: Knock Off
programme.desc: Marcus Ray (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sales representative for "V SIX" jeans, and his partner, Tommy Hendricks (Rob Schneider), are about to be busted for selling "knock off" jeans (a low-quality imitation of well-known products). Their American contact, Karen Leigh (Lela Rochon), who is not only their employer but a CIA agent sent to find the mole in their operation, is threatening them with a jail term if they do not prove their innocence.

programme.title: Thick as Thieves
programme.desc: Two master thieves go at odds with one another as one sets the other up for a crime. The first (Alec Baldwin), a suave pro who does his job and then hides in his own privacy, listening to old jazz records and caring for his ailing dog, Wally. The other (Michael Jai White) is a local gangster with a taste for the finer life, who decides to eliminate the competition. This ignites a war between the two men and their aides. An angry mob boss (David Byrd) and a female police officer (Rebecca De Mornay) try to sort the mess before things get too out of hand.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: While waiting for their flight in a bar of an airport, the writer Donovan Miller tells the story of his best-seller to a stranger to kill time. In Salt Lake City; Violet Madison, Austin Walker, Emma Scarlett and Jared Roth are good friends. After going together to a bar, Jared comes wounded to Austin's apartment in the late night and confesses that he is gay and has just killed a man in his apartment. He asks his friends to help him to vanish with the body of the victim. The group agrees, and after many incidents, Violet stresses, jeopardizing the group. When Violet is found, having hanged herself in her house, many secrets are disclosed.

programme.title: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Jason Price, a former NSA agent, operates the Daedalus network, which gives clients new identities and makes them disappear. As he lavishes a key witness against a lot of money and is hounded by a hitman (called the Cleaner), he not only sucks the FBI's anger, but also the crime syndicate Icarus, who also turns the cleaner on his best friend, the FBI agent Sonny begin. When Price also lets him submerge and shortly thereafter finds out Sonny's corpse, he realizes that the network has been infiltrated. Price follows the bloody trail of the Cleaner, which leads him not only to the true identity of the Cleaner, but also to its backers.

programme.title: Conspiracy
programme.desc: In the not so distant future, a team of white collar criminals are enlisted by the Federal government to thwart a cyber-attack that threatens to bankrupt the United States of America.

programme.title: Sirds robeža
programme.desc: Dziedātājs. Nemiernieks. Izraidītais. Varonis. Džonijs Kešs. Ar tik smagiem akordiem, kas spētu aizkustināt pat kravas vilcienu, tēraudpelēko acu intensīvo skatienu un balsi, tumšu kā nakts, leģendārais "Vīrs melnā" sarīkoja mūzikā revolūciju un pats radīja savu īstas amerikāņu leģendas imidžu. Būdams cilvēks, kura dzīvi vada spēcīgas kaislības, Džonijs Kešs nekad neatteicās no savas kontraversālās personības. Savas karjeras sākumā viņš satika vienīgo patieso savu mūža mīlestību Džūnu Kārteri, kas spēja viņu glābt no sevis paša.

programme.title: Apšaude
programme.desc: Spriedzes komēdija, Lielbritānija, 2016. / Režisors: Bens Vitlijs / Lomās: Enco Čilenti, Sems Railijs, Maikls Smailijs, Brī Larsone. Bostona, 1978.gads. Kad nelegālā ieroču tirdzniecība izgāžas, ieroču noliktava pārvēršas kaujas laukā. Vārdiem vairs nav vietas, jo runā stobri. Izdzīvošanas spēles galveno balvu, koferi ar milzu naudu, aiznest nav vienkārši. Apbruņoti ir visi, katrs cīnās par sevi un haoss valda pāri visam…

programme.title: Atriebība
programme.desc: Kad noslēpumains zvanītājs novieto spridzekli zem Meta Tērnera mašīnas sēdekļa, sākas strauja pakaļdzīšanās pāri visai pilsētai, lai izpildītu virkni specifisku uzdevumu. Ar bērniem uz aizmugurējā sēdekļa un spridzekli, kas eksplodēs, ja viņi izkāps no mašīnas, ikdienišķs brauciens kļūst par spēli uz dzīvību un nāvi. Lai izdzīvotu un glābtu savu ģimeni, Metam ierobežotā laikā jāizpilda aizvien bīstamākas svešinieka norādes.

programme.title: 13. Kareivis
programme.desc: Vīrietis, kurš iemīlējies nepareizajā sievietē, pēc sultāna pavēles tiek nosūtīts diplomātiskā misijā uz tālu zemi. Apstājoties vikingu ciematā, lai papildinātu krājumus, viņš negaidīti tiek ierauts bīstamā ceļojumā, lai stātos pretī noslēpumainiem draudiem tālā vikingu zemē.

programme.title: Algotnis
programme.desc: 23 gadīgais Mičs zaudējis savu līgavu teroristu uzbrukumā ir apsēsts ar atriebību. Viņš uzsāk apmācības specvienības rotā, lai atrastu un nogalinātu tos, kuri ir atbildīgi par viņas līgavas slepkavību. Par viņa instruktoru tiek nozīmēts Aukstā kara veterāns, ar kuru kopā viņi izmeklēs it kā savstarpēji nesaistītus teroristu uzbrukumus. Izmeklēšana viņus aizvedīs uz pēdām izbijušam CIP aģentam, kurš ir apmāts ar kara uzsākšanu Tuvajos austrumos.

programme.title: Sacīkste
programme.desc: 20. gadsimta septiņdesmitie gadi bija sacīkšu ēras zelta laiks: vienkāršotas formas sacīkšu automašīnas, piloti – brutāli trasē, bet jūtīgi un neaizsargāti reālajā dzīvē, seksīgas fanes un litriem šampanieša aiz finiša līnijas. Taču 1976. gada "Formula 1" sezonā vēl skaļāk par motoriem rūca nežēlīga sāncensība starp pilotiem Džeimsu Hantu un Nikiju Laudu. Viņi nemeklē vieglus ceļus uz uzvaru, taču viena neuzmanība, un sacīkste var pārtraukt ne tikai viņu karjeru, bet arī dzīvību.

programme.title: Cilvēks uz dzegas
programme.desc: Bijušais policists Niks Kesidijs, kurš netaisnīgi notiesāts uz 25 gadiem cietumā par neeksistējoša, neprātīgi dārga dimanta zādzību, izmanto pirmo izdevību, lai izbēgtu no ieslodzījuma. Viņa ceļš ved uz Manhetenas luksusa viesnīcu, kur Niks uzkāpj uz 21. stāva loga dzegas un draud nolēkt, piesaistot visas Ņujorkas uzmanību, medijus un policiju. Kamēr pieredzējusī sarunu vedēja Lidija Mersere cenšas atturēt Niku no liktenīgā soļa un saprast viņa motīvus, lejā pulcējas simtiem ziņkārīgo. Taču šķietamais pašnāvības mēģinājums ir tikai perfekti izplānots aizsegs. Kamēr visas pilsētas acis ir pievērstas vīram uz dzegas, pāri ielai Nika brālis un viņa draudzene uzsāk gadsimta pārdrošāko laupīšanu, lai atrastu it kā nozagto dimantu un pierādītu Nika nevainību. Pulkstenis tikšķ, un viena kļūda var maksāt dzīvību.

programme.title: Spartaks: Ašura māja
programme.desc: Pasaulē, kurā viņš ir pārdzīvojis seriāla "Spartaks" (2010) notikumus, Ašurs ir izcīnījis ceļu uz varu un kļuvis par īpašnieku tai pašai gladiatoru skolai, kas reiz piederēja viņam. Apvienojot spēkus ar sīkstu gladiatori, Ašurs aizsāk jauna veida izrādi, kas sanikno eliti.

programme.title: Killers. Pēdējā misija
programme.desc: Algots slepkava, kurš cieš no strauji progresējošas demences formas, iegūst iespēju izpirkt savu pagātni, izglābjot sava atsvešinātā pieaugušā dēla dzīvību.

programme.title: Bruklina
programme.desc: 1951. gada beigās Eilisa Leisija (Sīrša Ronana) pamet Īriju un dodas uz Bruklinu, lai sāktu jaunu dzīvi, atbalstot savu ģimeni. Viņai palīdz tēvs Flads, un Eilisa drīz nonāk dzīves ritenī, strādājot universālveikalā un studējot grāmatvedību. Kad viņa saskatās ar itāļu izcelsmes amerikāņu santehniķi, viņa saprot, ka ir pilnībā iemīlējusies. Taču pēc traģiska negadījuma viņai jādodas atpakaļ mājās, kur atjauno saites ar bijušajiem draugiem un mēģina izprast, kur veidot savu dzīvi tālāk.

programme.title: Nospiežot Sākt pogu
programme.desc: Kādai jaunai sievietei ir radusies iespēja glābt savu mūža mīlestību. Viņa viņa atklāj, ka abu kopīgi izgatavotā ierakstu izlases kasete var viņu pārcelt atpakaļ laikā.

programme.title: Ofēlija
programme.desc: Filmā "Ofēlija", kas veidota pēc Lisas Klainas romāna, Ofēlija, slavenā Šekspīra lugas "Hamlets" varone, vēsta savu versiju par to, kā patiesībā risinājās lugā aprakstītie notikumi. Ofēliju, dumpīgo, bez mātes augušo meiteni, pieņem audzināšanā karaliene Ģertrūde. Viņā iemīlas Ģertrūdes dēls princis Hamlets, un viņi slepus apprecas laikā, kad Dānijas karaļvalsti apdraud norvēģu iebrukums un galma iekšienē vērptās intrigas. Ofēlijai un Hamletam ir jāizvēlas starp mīlestību un atriebības alkām.

programme.title: Halloween Wars
programme.desc: Teams of cake decorators, candy-makers and pumpkin carvers compete to see who can make the biggest, wildest and spookiest edible Halloween creations. They may end up walking home with a big cash prize and scare viewers' pants off with some of the most amazing horror tales, all made from cake, candy and pumpkins. A sister show to "Holiday Wars" and an annual favorite, "Halloween Wars" has had new seasons every year since 2011. While the judges and hosts may change each year, the creativity never does.

programme.title: Last Bite Hotel
programme.desc: Host Tituss Burgess asks the remaining five chefs to create a stunning noodle dish for VIP guest and Iron Chef Michael Symon, using an ingredient bequeathed to them by a recently eliminated chef along with their own dwindling ingredients. The winning chef will inherit the rest of the bequeathed trunk, but the bottom two competitors will face off in a sudden-death cooking round highlighting the humble pickled egg. The losing chef will be forced into the mysterious Room 13, never to be seen again.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Chopped

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine visits Steak-N-Stuff, a family-run restaurant in Cottonwood, Arizona, where co-owners Mark and Susie are struggling to keep the place alive. Mark's son, Blake, wants more responsibility, but Mark is determined to do everything himself, even if it takes a serious toll on his already compromised health. It's up to Robert to unravel the truth behind this failing restaurant and help this family get back on track.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: Things keep turning into other things in the Research and Development Lab, and it's disturbingly delicious. John Henson pairs up the bakers into research teams, and they use exotic candy corn flavors as inspiration for lab specimen-stuffed desserts decorated with tongues, eyeballs, noses or toes. With elimination looming, the bakers serve judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell a mad menagerie of cutesy-to-creepy desserts by turning an adorable stuffy into a delicious, mutated monster.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine visits Greg's BBQ, a family restaurant in Belen, New Mexico, that's run by an ex-Marine who can't stop micromanaging his son who works alongside him. Owner Greg suffers from several health conditions and years of untreated stress, which is hurting the restaurant and putting his life in danger. Robert must teach Greg to trust his son, step back from the kitchen and start valuing his own health, before it kills him.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: Host John Henson has a close encounter with a ghost that inspires ghostly transformation desserts, and one supernatural sweet scares up $1,000 after impressing judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell. But the bottom three bakers aren't so lucky, and they must dig into their personal histories and create a ghost dessert based on an actual ancestor. In the end, the judges are met with their toughest decision of the series yet.

programme.title: Super Mega Cakes
programme.desc: As the most epic cake competition gets underway, Duff Goldman and his team go up against cake artist Elizabeth Rowe and her teammates Avalon Yarnes and Corinna Maguire in the first battle featuring cakes inspired by the world of comic book icon Superman. Meanwhile, Duff must also make five other cakes at the same time! Stretched thin and under constant pressure, Duff and his team must work fast and creatively to impress judges Amaury Guichon, Sherry Yard and special guest Beck Bennett if they want to win $10,000 and be eligible for the grand prize.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: To celebrate 85 years of the wonderful Wizard of Oz, John Henson is in the lab's atmospheric chamber measuring the velocity of tornado desserts so that the bakers can honor Dorothy's rough trip to Oz. Then, the bakers visit the acid pit, where the spirits have been melting things. Inspired by those who have melted before, especially the Wicked Witch of the West, the bakers make melted witch desserts to appease the spirits, as well as judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell.

programme.title: The Culprits of the War
programme.desc: Authors of War examines the powerful role writers and journalists play in shaping how conflicts are understood. Through letters, memoirs, reports and historical works, the series explores how those who documented wars helped preserve the experiences of soldiers and civilians. Each episode revisits major conflicts through the eyes of war correspondents, historians and authors whose words captured the realities of battle, the emotions of those involved and the lasting impact of war on societies and collective memory

programme.title: Treasures of the Nation
programme.desc: Audiences are taken on a journey to uncover Ukraine's most remarkable treasures, ranging from ancient artifacts and historical relics to significant cultural landmarks. Each episode explores the history, stories, and people behind these treasures, highlighting their cultural and historical importance. The program emphasizes preservation, discovery, and national pride, offering viewers an in-depth understanding of Ukraine's rich heritage and the efforts to protect and celebrate it.

programme.title: Defenders of the Sky
programme.desc: The sky is no longer just a symbol of freedom, but a critical battleground. This documentary offers an inside look at the individuals and systems dedicated to protecting airspace during times of conflict. Combining personal stories, real-life footage, and expert perspectives, it highlights the precision, pressure, and resilience required to respond to constant threats. As tensions rise, the film captures the human side of defense, revealing the courage and sacrifice behind those who stand guard above.

programme.title: Popular History
programme.desc: Freedom has shaped societies, inspired movements, and changed the course of history. It means having the courage to think independently, speak openly, make your own choices, and live according to your values. Yet freedom also comes with responsibility: understanding others, respecting differences, and protecting the rights that allow every person to seek a better future without fear or unnecessary limits.

programme.title: Destroyed by Russia
programme.desc: Across communities devastated by war, ordinary people face the loss of homes, livelihoods, and a sense of security. Through firsthand experiences and powerful testimonies, the documentary captures the human cost of destruction while highlighting resilience, solidarity, and the determination to rebuild. At its heart is a universal struggle for dignity, identity, justice, and the right to live in freedom.

programme.title: Cadets. Hostomel Border
programme.desc: This powerful documentary follows first-year military cadets who suddenly found themselves on the front lines during the early days of the war. Tasked with defending the critical Hostomel border leading into Kyiv, these young soldiers confronted immense danger to halt the advancing enemy forces. Through firsthand accounts and raw footage, the film delivers an inspiring story of bravery, sacrifice, and resilience.

programme.title: Lemāna-'66: Lielais izaicinājums
programme.desc: Filmas sižets balstīts patiesos notikumus un atgādina par autosporta vēstures spriedzes pilnām lapaspusēm. Notikumi risinās 60. gados, kad konstruktoru grupa, kuru vadīja Kerols Šelbijs, kopā ar britu sacīkšu braucēju Kenu Mailsu uzbūvēja vēl nebijušu "Ford" sporta automašīnu un meta izaicinājumu Lemānas 24 stundu sacīkšu favorītam "Ferrari".

programme.title: Izbrauciens
programme.desc: Bens Bārbers (Kevins Hārts) gatavojas precēties ar saderināto Andželu (Tika Samptere), kura ir viņa policijas partnera Džeimsa (Aiss Kjūbs) māsa. Policistus nosūta uzdevumā uz Maiami, lai izmeklētu nežēlīgā narkotiku tirgoņa Antonio Poupa (Bendžamins Brats) nodarījumus, par kuru ir zināms, ka tas apgādā visu Maiami ar narkotikām. Viņi apvienojas ar bezkompromisu detektīvi Maju (Olīvija Manna) un dodas pārtraukt Poupa darbību. Spriedze palielinās, tuvojoties Bena un Andželas kāzām.

programme.title: Ēnu spēks
programme.desc: Pāris, kura starpā jau sen vairs nevirmo romantika, kopā ar savu dēlu ir spiesti mesties bēgt no sava bijušā darba devēja – slepenās specvienības, kas nolēmusi no viņiem abiem atbrīvoties.

programme.title: Steidzies rītdien
programme.desc: Bezmiega nomocīts mūziķis sastop noslēpumainu svešinieku, aizsākot ceļojumu, kas izaicina visu, ko viņš zina par sevi.

programme.title: Rūķi
programme.desc: Hloja un viņas mamma pārvācas – jau ATKAL! Turklāt viņas pārvācas uz necilu, vecu māju, kas pilna ar dārza rūķiem. Drīz Hloja gan atklāj, ka šī māja slēpj biedējošu noslēpumu. Kādu dienu pēc skolas Hloja kopā ar kaimiņu Liamu atklāj, ka rūķi patiesībā ir dzīvi! Kā izrādās, jau gadiem rūķi ir sargājuši planētu no draudīgiem maziem monstriem, kuri iebrukuši mājā caur portālu, kas ved uz citu pasauli. Kad vienīgais līdzeklis, kas varētu palīdzēt uzveikt monstrus, skolā nonāk nepareizajās rokās, Hlojai un Liamam jāsadarbojas ar rūķiem, lai cīnītos pret mazo negantnieku iebrukumu un glābtu pasauli!

programme.title: Runcis zābakos
programme.desc: Vēl pirms leģendārais Runcis Zābakos satiek mums visiem jau zināmo zaļo briesmoni, vārdā Šreks, viņš dodas varonīgiem piedzīvojumiem pilnā ceļojumā, lai kopā ar ideju meistaru Oliņu Aleksandru Boliņu un drosmīgo kaķenīti Kitiju Maigķepu nozagtu Zosi, kas dēj zelta olas. Tas tik būs viens varens un deviņu dzīvību vērts piedzīvojums!

programme.title: Viens pats mājās
programme.desc: Baksteru ģimene pārceļas uz dzīvi citā štatā, taču 10 gadus veco Finnu biedē jaunā māja, jo viņš uzskata, ka tajā spokojas. Kamēr puisēns izliek slazdus, lai notvertu "spoku", viņa vecāki aizkavējas citā pilsētas malā, un viņš paliek mājās kopā ar māsu. Tikmēr trīs zagļi vēlas iegūt ārkārtīgi dārgu gleznu, kuru bijušais īpašnieks paslēpis slepenā telpā. Vai viņiem izdosies iegūt kāroto un uzvarēt kaujā ar mazo gudrinieku?

programme.title: Snūpijs un Čārlijs Brauns: Riekstiņu filma
programme.desc: Čarlijs Brauns, Snūpijs un visi pārējie atgriežas ar šo aizkustinošo stāstu. Kad apkārtnē uz dzīvi apmetas jauna sarkanmataina meitene, Čārlijs Brauns viņā iemīlas. Viņš vairākkārt mēģina pievērst jaunās meitenes uzmanību un dažādos veidos mēģina savā dzīvē kaut ko sasniegt, taču katru reizi šķiet, ka neveicas arvien vairāk. Vai viņam izdosies iepatikties savai mīlestībai? Tajā pašā laikā Snūpijs apņemas tikt galā ar savu ļaunāko ienaidnieku - Sarkano Baronu.

programme.title: Viens pats mājās
programme.desc: Ir pagājis labs laiks kopš Ziemassvētkiem, kad Makkalisteru ģimene, dodoties brīvdienās, pirmo reizi aizmirsa mājās Kevinu. Šos Ziemassvētkus Kevins nolēmis pavadīt sava tēta bagātās draudzenes Natālijas milzīgajā savrupmājā. Taču mierīgais vakars viņam kārtējo reizi izvēršas par īstu piedzīvojumu, jo Natālijas māju svētkos nolēmuši apciemot zagļi. Starp citu - vienam no viņiem ar Kevinu ir kārtojami veci rēķini!

programme.title: Sliktie
programme.desc: Leģendārais laupītāju piecinieks - Misters Vilks, Misters Čūska, Misters Piraija, Misters Haizivs un Mis Tarantula - bija labākie no sliktajiem, bet tagad ļoti cenšas būt labākie no labākajiem. Taču tā vietā viņi pret pašu gribu tiek iepīti jaunā, pasaules mēroga aplaupīšanas projektā, ko plāno kāda pārsteidzoša komanda - Sliktās meitenes. Vai Sliktajiem izdosies noturēties labo komandā? Kādi galvu reibinoši piedzīvojumi viņus sagaida šoreiz?

programme.title: Ferdinands
programme.desc: Ferdinands ir pats labsirdīgākais bullis visā Spānijā. Neskatoties uz iespaidīgajiem izmēriem un milzu spēku, viņš jau kopš bērnības neizrādīja sevišķu interesi par badīšanos ar saviem sugas brāļiem. Nejaušības dēļ Ferdinands nokļūst to vidū, kuri tiek izvēlēti, lai piedalītos buļļu cīņās Madridē. Tagad Ferdinandam nāksies aizstāvēt savus miermīlīgos dzīves uzskatus un atgādināt pārējiem, ka grūtību priekšā galvenais ir palikt, kāds tu esi. Jo tikai tā tu spēsi izmainīt pasauli sev apkārt.

programme.title: Meitene vārdā Vilo
programme.desc: Vilo manto mežu, māju un burvju spējas no savas vecmāmiņas Alvinas. Viņai jāatrod vēl trīs meitenes ar maģiskām dāvanām, lai izglābtu mežu. Par laimi, viņai līdzās ir lapsa Rufuss.

programme.title: Ingrīda - pašiņu karaliene
programme.desc: Ingrīda (Obrija Plaza) ir īstena sociālo tīklu stalkere, kuras dzīvē viens nejauši nospiests LIKE jau ir pielīdzināms īstai draudzībai, pat ja otra puse par to nemaz nenojauš. Teilore Slouna (Elizabete Olsena) ir atzīta Losandželosas sociālo tīklu karaliene un Instagrama zvaigzne, kuras līdz pēdējam pikselim noslīpētā, perfektā dzīve kļūst par Ingrīdas jaunāko apsēstību. Kad Ingrīda ar viltu ienāk Teilores dzīvē, viņu attiecības no #BFF ātri vien kļūst par #WTF. Un tas ir tikai sākums...

programme.title: After. Pēc kritiena
programme.desc: Tesa ir gatava jaunam dzīves posmam. Spožais prestižas koledžas diploms paver jaunas iespējas – meitene atrod sapņu darbu starptautiskā kompānijā. Viņas nodoms pārcelties uz Sietlu nemaz neiepriecina Hārdinu. Viņa neapmierinātība, pārmetumi un mūžīgā greizsirdība sāpīgi ievaino Tesu un rada bažas. Vai ir vērts visu likt uz kārts un upurēt daudzsološu karjeru? Taču kā lai aizmirst kopā pavadītās naktis un kaislīgos skūpstus, viņa ciešos vīrieša apskāvienus un tuvību, kas padara traku?

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Nekustamo īpašumu aģents Tomass Haters dodas uz Transilvāniju, lai satiktu grāfu Orloku. Tikmēr viņa līgavu Elenu sāk mocīt šausminošas vīzijas par vampīru.

programme.title: Ups! Piedzīvojumi turpinās
programme.desc: Uz Noasa šķirsta kļūst nemierīgi – kuģis pārāk ilgi kuģo pa jūru, zeme nav redzama un pārtikas krājumi sarūk arvien vairāk. Kādu dienu ceļotāji patiešām atklāj salu, taču uz tās ir aktīvs vulkāns, un arī salas iedzīvotāji nav visai viesmīlīgi.

programme.title: Ceļotāju paaudze
programme.desc: Viņi ir radīti mēģenē un īpaši gatavoti šai misijai. No šiem cilvēkiem ir atkarīgs visas cilvēces liktenis. Tāltālajā ceļojumā sūtītie jaunieši ir saikne starp pagātnes un nākotnes paaudzēm. Pēc dīvainās jauniešu audzinātāja nāves viņu dzīve kļūst nekontrolēta. Viņi vairs nedzer medikamentus, un viņus pārņem līdz šim svešas cilvēciskas jūtas un vēlmes - mīlestība un kaisle.

programme.title: Mīlestība dejas ritmā
programme.desc: Talantīgā balerīna Bārlova nolēmusi īstenot savu sapni Amerikas mākslas svētnīcā Ņujorkā. Diemžēl iepazīšanās ar svētnīcas realitāti nav īpaši patīkama – pieredzējusī baleta pasniedzēja Oksana skaidri un gaiši pasaka: Bārlova vēl nav ne tuvu pilnībai. Norijusi krupi, meitene nepadodas un piedalās jaunas Brodvejas deju izrādes atlasē. Režisors Zanders pievērš uzmanību Bārlovai un izvēlas viņu mēģinājumiem. Pēc dažām dienām topošās izrādes kodolam pievienojas talantīgais pianists Čārlijs. Tāpat kā Bārlova, viņš ieradies Ņujorkā, lai īstenotu sapni. Puisim un meitenei rodas simpātijas vienam pret otru, bet Zanders nav vienaldzīgs pret meiteni. Bārlova drīz vien sapinas mīlas trīsstūrī. Izrādes mēģinājumi kļūst arvien intensīvāki, slodze aug, un ne Bārlovai, ne Čārlijam neatliek laika nekam citam. Darbs vaiga sviedros, nemitīgā spriedze, sāncenšu nodevība un cīņa bez kompromisiem prasa visus spēkus.

programme.title: Ķieģeli pa ķieģelītim
programme.desc: Animācijas filma "Lego" klucīšu stilā par Farela Viljamsa dzīvi. Filmā, kurā galvenās lomas ierunājis pats Farels Viljamss (Pharrell Williams), kā arī Kendriks Lamārs (Kendrick Lamar) un Džastins Timberleiks (Justin Timberlake), ķieģelīti pa ķieģelītim tiek pārskatīta mākslinieka karjera.

programme.title: Pie visa vainīga mīlestība
programme.desc: Žoslēns ir veiksmīgs biznesmenis, toties mīlas dzīvē – patmīlīgs brunču mednieks. Kad viņš mēģina jau atkal savaldzināt jaunu sievieti, izliekoties, ka ir ratiņkrēslā, viņa iepazīstina Žoslēnu ar savu māsu, kura patiešām piesaistīta dzīvei ratiņkrēslā.

programme.title: Dogmens
programme.desc: Kad uzticīgais policijas suns un viņa saimnieks dežūras laikā gūst ievainojumus, ārsti paveic dzīvību glābjošu operāciju, un no viņiem abiem top viens - atjautīgais Dogmens! Viņš dod svinīgo policista zvērestu aizsargāt un kalpot. Tikko Dogmens sāk pildīt policista uzdevumus un cenšas atstāt labu iespaidu uz priekšnieku, viņam tiek sarežģīts uzdevums - jāaptur superļaundara kaķa Pītija varenais plāns.

programme.title: Ēnu spēle
programme.desc: Treviss Bloks ir FIB problēmu risinātājs. Kad slepenie aģenti nonāk nepatikšanās, Treviss tiek izsaukts, lai viņus izpestītu. Par katru cenu. Taču, kad viens no slepenajiem aģentiem apšauba savas priekšniecības patiesos mērķus, Treviss nonāk asiņainas sazvērestības epicentrā.

programme.title: Grāfs Monte-Kristo
programme.desc: Izbēdzis no cietuma uz salas, kurā, nepatiesi apsūdzēts par valsts nodevību, pavadījis četrpadsmit gadus, Edmunds Dantess atgriežas kā grāfs Monte-Kristo, lai atriebtos vīriem, kas viņu nodevuši.

programme.title: Kā pieradināt pūķi
programme.desc: Skarbajā Berkas salā vikingi un pūķi ir bijuši ienaidnieki paaudžu paaudzēs. Šeit dzīvo Hikaps - jaunietis ar izgudrotāja spējām, varenā vikinga Lielā Stoika dēls. Hikaps pārkāpj gadsimtiem ilgas tradīcijas, sadraudzējoties ar Nezobu - mītiem apvīto Tumsas pūķi. Viņu neticamā draudzība atklās pūķu patieso dabu un pavērs ceļu jaunai ērai pūķu un vikingu pasaulē.

programme.title: Minioni
programme.desc: Minjoni, kas attīstījās no dzelteniem vienšūnas organismiem, dzīvo uz Zemes kopš aizvēsturiskiem laikiem. Viņu dzīves jēga ir kalpošana, taču mazie radījumi nemitīgi atrod sev nekam nederīgus saimniekus, sākot no dinozaura un beidzot ar Napoleonu. Ja minjoniem nav saimnieka, kuram zemoties, viņi ieslīgst dziļā depresijā. Taču minjonam Kevinam ir plāns – kopā ar draugiem Stjuartu un Bobu viņš dodas meklēt jaunu ļauno saimnieku, kuram sekot. Tā viņi atrod Skārletu Nomušītu, kas ir pasaulē pirmā superļaundare.

programme.title: Bīstamās līgavas māsas
programme.desc: Kad naudaskāri bandīti grib sagrābt greznu kāzu viesus par ķīlniekiem, viņi vēl nezina, ka līgavas māsa ir slepenā aģente, kura ir gatava uz visu, ja kāds mēģinās izjaukt viņas labākās draudzenes kāzas.

programme.title: Vienvirziena reiss
programme.desc: Fredijs ir sīks zaglēns, kurš ir iekūlies lielās nepatikšanās. Pār plecu viņam ir soma pilna ar skaidru naudu un kokaīnu, bet vēderā lode. Vai Fredijam izdosies aizbēgt, pirms viņam beigsies laiks?

programme.title: Pašpaļāvība
programme.desc: Tomijam tiek piedāvāts viens miljons dolāru, lai piedalītos izdzīvošanās spēlē, kurā īsti mednieki viņu mēģinās nogalināt. Viņš piekrīt, jo ir pārliecināts, ka atradis "robu" noteikumos - uzbrukt viņam drīkst tikai tad, kad viņš ir vienatnē. Vienīgā problēma, neviens no viņa draugiem un ģimenes netic, ka spēle ir īsta.

programme.title: Brīvības skaņa
programme.desc: Filmas pamatā ir neticami patiess stāsts par federālo aģentu Timu Balārdu, kurš veltījis savu dzīvi cīņai ar bērnu tirdzniecību. Pēc jauna zēna izglābšanas no nežēlīgiem bērnu tirgotājiem Balārds uzzina, ka zēna māsa joprojām ir gūstā, un nolemj uzsākt bīstamu misiju viņas glābšanai. Viņš pamet savu oficiālo darbu un dodas dziļi Kolumbijas džungļos, liekot savu dzīvi uz bīstamas spēles, lai atbrīvotu sagūstītos bērnus no likteņa, kas ir briesmīgāks par nāvi.

programme.title: Basketbols: Eirolīga. Valencia - Baskonia
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: The series will follow collectors as they discover the true monetary value of their massive and unusual collections, after which they must decide whether they are willing to sell some of their items to pay for a much-needed home renovation.

programme.title: Bargain Block
programme.desc: Bargain Block follows home renovation experts and partners Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas on their journey to restore Detroit's iconic American neighborhoods one house at a time. With sound advice and support from their friend—lifetime Detroit resident and real estate expert Shea Hicks-Whitfield, who is expecting her first child—Keith and Evan buy multiple rundown and abandoned houses on a single block, take them down to the studs, and create affordable, stylish and fully furnished starter homes that are ideal for first-time homebuyers. Now settled in the Motor City, the couple, who have renovated and purchased their own home and opened a new retail store and workshop, infuse every property with a functional layout, artful design and beautiful repurposed furniture. The end result is incredible transformations of dilapidated homes that are an inspiration to the entire neighborhood.

programme.title: We Bought A Funeral Home
programme.desc: We Bought A Funeral Home is an eerie new series that will unearth an unconventional side of the home renovation realm. The six episodes will document the quirky journey of Heather and Arryn Blumberg and their two kids, Rafferty and Noa, who trade in big city life to buy, renovate and design a 12,000-square-foot, 1800s Victorian funeral home in the small town of Dresden, Ontario.

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: An engaged Seattle couple wants to leave city life and escape to Bainbridge island, Washington. She's hoping to find a large yard for a new dog or their future kids, while he wants a turnkey house close to the ferry.

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: A Washington family is moving to Fidalgo Island to get their kids outdoors more and bring all the joys of camping to everyday life. They hope to find a spacious home with a large kitchen and a dining room for family dinners.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programme.desc: Recent lottery winners look for their perfect dream house in this "House Hunters"-inspired reality show. David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or hundreds of millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market. Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find "My Lottery Dream Home".

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Attempting to bring families' dreams come to life, but on a budget, Beachfront Bargain Hunt shows that you don't have to be a millionaire if you want to live a life by the sea! Narrated by John Beach, this show follows a number of couples, families and people looking just for themselves exploring various beachfront's in USA, looking for homes that won't break the bank. Ensuring each person gets what they want, they are introduced to a number of properties that meet their ultimate dream home in the hopes that they will indeed find the one. With 101 episodes, Beachfront Bargain Hunt introduces you to the life that can be led, without breaking to bank, to live a life by the sea!

programme.title: House Hunters
programme.desc: American reality series following host Suzanne Whang on her quest to help people relocate in search of their dream home. Follow the individuals, couples and families in an international search for their perfect property, exploring a stunning selection of homes chosen just for them. With three potential candidates to choose from, join them as they try and make the difficult decision to start a new life abroad. Revisit the new homeowners at the end of each episode to see how their properties have developed and how life has changed for them since the move.

programme.title: Island Life
programme.desc: Pablo and Michelle are a newly engaged couple with a romantic story. programme.title: Fixer To Fabulous
programme.desc: The minute Elly Elliott saw her 1902 home, she fell in love with it and made an offer before her husband, Phillip, had ever seen the house. Once Phillip finally did see it, his reaction was the complete opposite. He was not happy about the prospect of living in this home that, in his eyes, was just too old and outdated to ever make it their "forever home." Now, with the help of Dave and Jenny Marrs, Elly is eager to show Phillip how they can renovate and update the house to make this their dream home, all while preserving the 1902 charm that Elly loves. Even though Philip is still skeptical and toys around with moving into another home, Elly is confident Dave and Jenny can turn this house into a home Phillip will love as much as she does.

programme.title: Design Down Under

programme.desc: Bargain Block follows home renovation experts and partners Keith Bynum and Evan Thomas on their journey to restore Detroit's iconic American neighborhoods one house at a time. programme.title: Fix My Frankenhouse

Mike employs his construction know-how to create a functional flow, while Denese will capture the clients' style with custom finishes. programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Ancient Astronaut theorists have suggested that many of the divine beings depicted in cultures throughout the world are not really divine--or mythological--but instead reflect extraterrestrial visitations that our ancestors did not understand. Might there have been numerous alien species inhabiting Earth? Could the accounts given by modern day alien abductees be evidence that these otherworldly entities continue to visit Earth to this day? And is it possible that they all have a common ancestor? In 1928, archaeologist Julio Tello discovered the Paracas skulls of Peru--elongated heads with cranial volumes at least 25% larger than the largest known human skulls. Some believe that these remains are of extraterrestrial origin.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Billions of dollars have been spent in our quest to find an "other Earth." Since the launch of the Kepler Telescope in 2009, scientists have identified thousands of planets capable of supporting life. Is it possible that this discovery finally answers the age-old question: "Are we alone in the universe?" Could it be that just as we seek out other habitable planets, advanced extraterrestrials from distant galaxies did the same with Earth in the remote past? Throughout world mythologies, there are tales of beings from the stars coming down to Earth. The Dogon tribe in Africa believes their gods came from the Sirius star system. The Maya associated their gods with the Pleiades star cluster. And according to the Hopi tradition, life itself was seeded by celestial beings. Ancient Astronaut theorists propose that not only has our planet been visited by extraterrestrials, but that they are responsible for our very existence.

programme.title: Hazardous History with Henry Winkler
programme.desc: You thought your job was tough? Uncover the downright dangerous gigs of the past—from mercury-poisoned hat makers to kids crawling through chimneys—and imagine the shocking risks behind everyday jobs that were once accepted without question.

programme.title: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: Rivaling the famous Area 51 in Nevada for UFO sightings and paramormal activity, is the lesser known, but equally fascinating, Uinta Basin in Utah and, in particular, Skinwalker Ranch. For the first time, a team of scientists and experts have been granted unlimited access to the infamous and secretive 512-acre property in order to unlock the mysteries of more than 200 years of UFO activity, bizarre animal mutations and preternatural phenomena. Making good use of state-of-the-art tecnology such as drone thermography, ground-penetrating radar and lasers, the team apply their knowledge and expertise to make shocking discoveries.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Billions of dollars have been spent in our quest to find an "other Earth." Since the launch of the Kepler Telescope in 2009, scientists have identified thousands of planets capable of supporting life. Is it possible that this discovery finally answers the age-old question: "Are we alone in the universe?" Could it be that just as we seek out other habitable planets, advanced extraterrestrials from distant galaxies did the same with Earth in the remote past? Throughout world mythologies, there are tales of beings from the stars coming down to Earth. The Dogon tribe in Africa believes their gods came from the Sirius star system. The Maya associated their gods with the Pleiades star cluster. And according to the Hopi tradition, life itself was seeded by celestial beings. Ancient Astronaut theorists propose that not only has our planet been visited by extraterrestrials, but that they are responsible for our very existence.

programme.title: Hazardous History with Henry Winkler
programme.desc: You thought your job was tough? Uncover the downright dangerous gigs of the past—from mercury-poisoned hat makers to kids crawling through chimneys—and imagine the shocking risks behind everyday jobs that were once accepted without question.

programme.title: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: Rivaling the famous Area 51 in Nevada for UFO sightings and paramormal activity, is the lesser known, but equally fascinating, Uinta Basin in Utah and, in particular, Skinwalker Ranch. For the first time, a team of scientists and experts have been granted unlimited access to the infamous and secretive 512-acre property in order to unlock the mysteries of more than 200 years of UFO activity, bizarre animal mutations and preternatural phenomena. Making good use of state-of-the-art tecnology such as drone thermography, ground-penetrating radar and lasers, the team apply their knowledge and expertise to make shocking discoveries.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: Tony Harris separates the real from the fake in some of the most compelling Bigfoot evidence recently captured. Are footprint casts from Mt. St. Helens proof that a massive, undiscovered primate lives in North America? Have a father and son team captured the most convincing footage of Bigfoot since the famous Patterson-Gimlin film, using a thermal imaging camera? Harris and a collection of top researchers, investigators, academics, and scientists, evaluate the latest and most intriguing sounds, photos and videos, to analyze and pass verdicts on their authenticity...

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: In August of 2014, Russian cosmonauts aboard the International Space Station discovered something incredibly unexpected covering parts of the windows--living sea plankton. If sea life can thrive in space, might the reverse be true as well? Might there be alien life forms that inhabit our seas? Throughout history, there have been tales of strange creatures hiding in Earth's waters. While many discount stories of sea monsters as purely mythological, it is estimated that Earth's oceans are home to between 700,000 to one million species--and shockingly, two-thirds of those species still remain unknown. Considering the recent discovery that some sea life can survive in outer space, is it possible that tales of giant creatures like the Kraken and The Loch Ness Monster are evidence of extraterrestrial entities taking refuge beneath the seas?

programme.title: Mankind Decoded
programme.desc: Using dramatic reconstructions, this fascinating documentary series explores the evolution and advancement of the human race, dissecting the key events and changes that have affected and altered various civilisations. Each episode in this 12-part series focusses on a unique transformation of our ancestors, as they discovered more and more about the planet they inhabit. With expert historians offering explanations to these changes, the series reveals how powerful forces of nature compelled humans to adapt, the birth of war, the discovery of fire and metals, and the building of giant structures, among many others.

programme.title: Lost Gold of WW2
programme.desc: It is the last great mystery of WWII. The fabled Yamashita Treasure, a massive stash of gold bars and rubies worth billions, reportedly dumped in a cave by Japanese soldiers retreating from allied forces. While the fortune has become a legend, many experts claim there is no evidence it ever existed. Now, a dedicated group of investigators are resurrecting the dangerous search, using cutting-edge technology in pursuit of the truth, and unimaginable wealth.

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, the stars of History's "The Curse of Oak Island," learn of a new mystery that may even rival Oak Island's. Michigan native Kevin Dykstra is obsessed with a deathbed confession made by a lighthouse keeper in the 1890s about a national treasure dating back to the Civil War. The story goes that Union soldiers tracked down Confederate president Jefferson Davis in 1865 and confiscated his gold. The stolen loot was smuggled north some years later but ended up in Lake Michigan, where Dykstra believes it still remains. His quest to prove it ultimately takes him and his team to the bottom of Lake Michigan.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Former Green Berry Terry Schappert explores the stories of some of the most iconic warrior groups in history, including their weaponry, training, fighting tactics and more. The veteran investigates what made these legendary fighters great, but also what were their weaknesses. Join him as he looks into the battling masteries of the Vikings, the Samurai, the Spartans and more.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: The Aborigines of Australia are the oldest, continuously surviving society on Earth. The stories preserved in their oral tradition are said to date back over 60,000 years, to an era they call the "Dreamtime" and contain fascinating descriptions about how life began and our planet was seeded by extraterrestrials. Linguistic experts have just discovered that many of these indigenous legends can be scientifically verified by examining the geological record. Ancient Astronaut theorists propose that if the Aboriginal's oral traditions are indeed this accurate, then perhaps the tales they tell about sky gods visiting Earth in large, fire-spewing crafts are true as well. Could the ultimate evidence about our extraterrestrial past be found within the sacred stories, sites, and rituals of Australia's Wisdom Keepers?

programme.title: Ancient Top
programme.desc: Ancient Top 10 is smart, fun countdown that details how ancient technology worked, how surprisingly advanced it was, and how it was kind of awesome. Location shooting, CGI, and graphics are pulled from past History series Ancient Impossible and Ancient Discoveries, and lists are organized by themes. The stories are augmented by new entries fueled by the History archive. Episodes include updated "Top Ten" graphics and new interviews that provide "wow" facts and explain why something made the list. The lists will have organizing principles so it doesn't seem arbitrary. Episodes could include the following: Top 10 Secrets of Egypt, Top 10 Ancient Vikings, Top 10 Greek Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Weapons, Top 10 Ancient Monuments, Top 10 Ancient Ships, Top 10 Torture Devices, Top 10 Roman Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Swords, and Top 10 Ancient Sieges.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: The deadliest natural weapon employed in the animal kingdom, venom has independently evolved in creatures as diverse as jellyfish, insects, snakes, and even mammals. Scientists from around the globe show how evolution adapted venom to fit the needs of the animals who wield it. Injecting venom into samples of his blood, Australia's Bryan Fry demonstrates how the world's deadliest snake, the inland taipan, has converted the building blocks of its body into lethal toxins. Toto Olivera will introduce us to the cone snail, pound-for-pound the most toxic creature in the world, able to continually update its chemical cocktails with the help of the world's fastest-evolving genes, guaranteeing the creatures stay one step ahead of their prey.

programme.title: Ancient Impossible
programme.desc: Ancient Impossible, the new H2 series, picks up where HISTORY's long running Ancient Discoveries left off. In this next generation of storytelling, Ancient Impossible reveals how many of today's technological achievements were actually developed centuries ago. But when she disappears after a date with the scion of a well-known local family, it sends local law enforcement scrambling to find her before the case goes cold.

programme.title: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace
programme.desc: This docuseries offers extraordinary access & exclusive insight into a mystery ripped straight from the headlines. Initially assumed to be a 6-year-old Ukrainian orphan with a rare bone growth disorder that can result in skeletal abnormalities as well as issues with hearing and vision, Natalia was adopted by the Barnett's in 2010. Unfolding over multiple parts, ID presents an unparalleled deep dive into this shocking family saga.

programme.title: The Interrogator
programme.desc: As she's leaving for work, a young woman finds her sister shot to death on the pavement just outside their apartment. The victim, Aidee Reyna, was out celebrating her 30th birthday with friends just hours before. After interviewing multiple witnesses and suspects, including her ex-husband and a shady ex-boyfriend, Detective Fil Waters uncovers a shocking lead that ultimately connects the killer to the victim's bank card. The most unnerving part? The confession is caught on video.

programme.title: The Interrogator
programme.desc: Two generations of the tight-knit Contreras family are shot in broad daylight while they are working at their family-owned car dealership, and a small community is left in shock. programme.title: Extreme Forensics
programme.desc: Often, some of the most bizarre and baffling criminal mysteries can only be solved using the expertise, skill and diligence of the members of the forensics department. This show reveals new and never-before-seen techniques which the teams use to solve the most puzzling of crimes. We follow cases such as when two construction workers are found dead after eight shots are heard in a New Jersy motel room, there are no witnesses and no obvious motive and only one piece of evidence holds the key; or when a fifteen-year-old girl is savagely beaten and killed in an Ohio cemetery and forensic professionals have to come up with a DNA sample when none exists; or when a 55-year-old man disapperas from a quiet Mississippi River town only for his skull to be discovered months later and hundreds of miles away buried in concrete at a truck stop.

programme.title: 13 клиническая
programme.desc: Неизлечимо больной хирург Кирилл находит работу в клинике, где врачи борются со сверхъестественными явлениями. Единственный способ выжить - показать себя с лучшей стороны и убедить новое руководство, что он нужен больнице. Кирилл погружается в хитросплетения отношений людей, ведьм и демонов, все больше сомневаясь, что он способен правильно определить, кто именно здесь представляет добро, а кто - зло. Диагностика неидеальна, и врагом может оказаться тот, кто изначально им не казался. Чтобы избежать таких ошибок, Кириллу и его коллегам придется провести немало времени, изучая обстоятельства болезней пациентов.

programme.title: Кухня
programme.desc: "Во все времена еда была рядом с людьми. Она искушает, вдохновляет, восхищает, отвращает. Но человек не может без еды, а значит тот, кто создает еду, может управлять миром…". Так думал Максим Лавров, когда шел осуществлять свою мечту — устраиваться поваром в один из самых дорогих ресторанов столицы. Мечта сбылась, вот только на деле все вышло не так вкусно. Шеф-повар ресторана Виктор Баринов — настоящая звезда гастрономического бомонда, знающая как угодить взыскательной публике. Оборотная сторона этого идеального образа — злоупотребление алкоголем, страсть к азартным играм и невыносимый характер. В гневе Баринов страшен, в загуле — неукротим. Арт-директор Виктория Гончарова — настоящая снежная королева, карьеристка с ледяным сердцем, однако именно с ней Макс проводит ночь до того, как пойти на новую работу. А вся команда поваров только и ждет промашки новичка, чтобы от души посмеяться.
